newsitem.title: UK: UK traders face tough new risk-rating system - paper.
newsitem.headline: UK traders face tough new risk-rating system - paper.

text.p: London's trading and broking houses are to have tough new risk ratings imposed on them by financial markets watchdog the Securities and Futures Authority (SFA), a British newspaper reported on Thursday.

The Times said the SFA would next week unveil a risk-rating system under which its members would be judged by yardsticks including financial stability of the company, quality and strength of its management and internal control systems.
These and other factors would be fed into an SFA mechanism to produce individual risk ratings, the newspaper said.

The Times said SFA members would be told their ratings this summer. The ratings would determine the amount of spare capital members would have to post to cover their business exposure in the markets, as well as the level of attention and inspection they would receive from the SFA.
